integrity: The proof uses Fu–Li's published extreme-point reduction for polyhedral Radon planes, proves the regular 4m+2 polygon is Radon via the polar quarter-turn relation, classifies all Birkhoff-orthogonal vertex indices, and evaluates the two possible polygonal chord norms exactly. The bundled enumerator independently checks all vertex pairs for m up to 100; finite computation is not used as the proof of the infinite family. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers Euclidean regular polygons with side count congruent to 2 modulo 4. It does not compute the Massera–Schäffer Birkhoff constant outside this Radon residue class or for arbitrary affine polygonal deformations, and it does not classify every maximizer.
title: Massera--Schäffer constants of regular \(4m+2\)-gonal Radon planes
